name: OMAN Telecom SAOG
ceo: Eng. Alaa Al Din Abdullah Hassan Bait Fadhil
description: Oman Telecommunications Company SAOG (Omantel) is the Sultanate's leading integrated telecommunications operator and digital connectivity provider, alongside controlling regional telecom platform Zain Group across eight MENA markets. In Oman, Omantel leads mobile postpaid and prepaid services (Baqati and Hayyak), 5G and Fiber-to-the-Room home broadband (Baiti), international wholesale connectivity, and enterprise ICT. Through its national digital arm Otech, the Group delivers sovereign cybersecurity, cloud, and AI mandates for major institutions including the Ministry of Finance and Central Bank of Oman. Consolidating Zain Group's operations across Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Kuwait, Jordan, Sudan, and Bahrain gives Omantel broad regional scale with 9M 2026 consolidated revenues of OMR 2.58B.
highlights: 9M 2026 consolidated revenue grew 2.4% YoY to OMR 2,579.8M, while net profit attributable to shareholders surged 52.2% to OMR 84.8M.
Standalone Oman revenues rose 8.5% YoY to OMR 535.2M in 9M 2026, driven by core telecom growth, ICT, and Otech enterprise contracts.
FY2025 Financial Snapshot: Revenue of OMR 3.41B and Net Profit of OMR 371.01M (Total Assets: OMR 9.17B).
Ownership Registry (mcd.om): 20,598 registered shareholders • Omani 96.7% | GCC 1.9% | Foreign & Arab 1.4% (2 disclosed 5%+ holders).
